# Bundled animation libraries

These scripts are served from the local application directory; the interface requires no CDN or third-party connection at runtime.

* GSAP 3.13.0 — https://gsap.com/ — original copyright/license header retained in `gsap.min.js`. License: https://gsap.com/standard-license/. Downloaded from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.13.0/dist/gsap.min.js.
* Lenis 1.3.17 — https://lenis.dev/ — MIT license in `LENIS-LICENSE.txt`. Downloaded from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/lenis@1.3.17/dist/lenis.min.js.

Design references: TensorFlow Playground (inspectable signed weights), Lenis (fluid interaction), and basement.studio (editorial scale and contrasting chapter art direction). No third-party site assets were copied.
